deviations: Reconciliation cases are derived from PH-354 precheck issues with a stable identity of period|domain|owner + normalized source identities (version excluded) + rule_code; evidence changes supersede the prior draft/pending row. approved rows are never overwritten by refresh; issues whose refs cannot be normalized are surfaced in missing instead of creating a case. Active cases whose issue disappears are not auto-closed; they are listed in stale_case_keys for human follow-up.

difference_cents is a non-null canonical SignedCnyCents: owner-provided value first, then a cents pair parsed from expected/actual (including owner dicts such as {'max_cents': 10000}), else a true 0 for issues with no monetary difference. No conservation assertion is made.

snapshot_watermark is an array of canonical SourceRefs pointing at the PH-354 period-precheck snapshot; the business date travels in its optional external_key so no non-canonical snapshot_as_of column is added. An older as_of refresh cannot overwrite a newer snapshot.

No canonical insights.reconciliation_* events are emitted in this slice; ReconciliationRefresh org+request_token receipts are the internal idempotency/history evidence, recorded as a first-slice limitation.
SQLite/PostgreSQL append-only triggers protect case identity columns and both internal read-model tables; only status/owner/resolution_note/version/updated_* may change on a case.
unverified: Real PostgreSQL concurrency, select_for_update locking and CI Linux/PG execution (SQLite scoped).
